sections.supportingCopy: Frontline delivers the strategic function of a CIO alongside the governance apparatus most SMBs cannot staff internally. Clients engage us as a strategic partner embedded in their planning, budgeting, and governance cycles — not as a transactional vendor.

sections.label: Questions we hear
sections.title: The conversations that should be happening in the executive room.

questions.text: Your team is already using AI. Do you know which tools, with what data?
Is company data leaving your organization through AI tools you haven't sanctioned?
Are you ready for CMMC, NIST, HIPAA, or your next security review?
Do you have an AI policy — or is it a document nobody reads?
Are your IT procedures documented — or does one person simply know everything?
Who is managing your vendors, contracts, renewals, and costs?

sections.closingLine: These are the questions Frontline is built to answer.

sections.label: Service lines
sections.title: Four lines. One partner.
sections.aside: Frontline works as a single partner across leadership, governance, AI enablement, and managed services — so technology decisions stay connected to the business and to the controls that protect it.
